phases.coverage: Every region × supported default main/method × explicitly selected side; balanced, authored, four servings.
Every region/main-method receives five seeded cases, all five heats and servings 1/2/4/6/12; cleaner knobs and all sides rotate.
Every supported chosen-cut/method × every region; sides, heat, servings and authored/seeded cases rotate.
Every diet × every region × every side; compatible main/methods rotate. This is not every dietary main/method Cartesian product.
Every classic × classic regional profile × all five diets, authored and seed7; heat and servings rotate.

checks: positive finite quantities and total time
ingredient name, ID or authored whole-phrase alias occurs in method
exact allergen-tag union and diet exclusions
one explicit regional finish; complete-meal finish after main
limits: This checks authored content and recorded ingredient tags, not actual cooking, taste, packet contents or cross-contact.
All authored balanced combinations are exhaustive only after a completed full authored phase.
Seed/heat/serving/clean and cut/diet variants use the stated rotating cases, not every possible input Cartesian product.
Source hash covers local lib/*.ts at start and end; changing source invalidates the run.
